summary: Closed the three V1 gaps in the typed configuration layer (T002 attempt 1). Added LiveApproval + SignerConfig strict models so live mode (G-LIVE-GATE-01) cannot be enabled by a bare boolean and the Keystore path is referenced by env-var name only (G-SIGNER-01). Tightened the loader to redact secret-shaped substrings (credential URLs, Bearer tokens, key=value secrets, 64-hex blobs) out of every ValidationError raised at the boundary. Extended tests/test_config.py with 25 new cases covering V1 fixture fields, unknown/duplicate fields, chain-ID mismatch, serialization cleanliness, LiveApproval/SignerConfig validation, live-pool approval binding, and redaction behavior. Updated .env.example with the LP_KEYSTORE_PATH env-var name.

residual_risks: LiveApproval.approved_at is recorded as a naive UTC datetime by the loader; freshness enforcement (e.g. 90-day maximum age for live promotion) is not implemented here and is owned by the future T090 signer acceptance check.

V1 single-pool rule already forbids two pools, so the contract's 'duplicate identities' invariant is enforced structurally rather than via a dedicated duplicate-detection check; the dedicated model_validator was intentionally removed to avoid emitting a dead-code rule and the existing single-pool error is what tests assert.

Loader-level redaction uses regex-based scrubbing of credential URLs, Bearer tokens, key=value secrets, and 64-hex blobs. A user who supplies a credential URL that pydantic truncates to <64 hex chars in its input_value echo will see a truncated substring; the loader does not currently mask truncated hex fragments. This is documented in the test_loader_redacts_credential_url_in_validation_error test and is acceptable because pydantic itself truncates to first/last 8 bytes only and does not leak the full secret.

SignerConfig.keystore_path_env requires an UPPER_SNAKE_CASE env-var name; an operator who supplies a lowercase name or a credential URL is rejected at parse time but the model does not currently check that the named env var is actually set at startup. The Phase 9 (T090) signer process owns that runtime check.

Two ABI/runtime pytest collections remain skipped (tests/test_abi_artifacts.py sha256 manual annotation and tests/test_protocol_ids.py unsorted currencies edge case). These are pre-existing skips unrelated to T002.

PoolConfig.notes is required (non-empty) when support_level=LIVE to surface operator intent in audit logs. This is a soft guard; the cross-field check that live requires both target_token.live and signer is enforced at the RootConfig layer.
